description: This file defines the ScheduledInterviewSummary class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for the dashboard's action summary related to scheduled interviews. It implements methods to retrieve group info and count pending actions for candidates scheduled for interviews.

classes.name: ScheduledInterviewSummary
classes.description: Represents a summary of scheduled interviews for the dashboard, including methods to retrieve group info and count of pending actions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the instance with accessible candidate IDs.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the ID for the group, which is 5.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the group name 'Candidates To Interview'.

methods.name: getPendingActionCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of actionable scheduled interviews for the accessible candidates.
